notes: One undated handwritten list page with seven SGA-related task entries. It mentions weak Lefschetz under the stated smoothness condition, Q-ell sheaves and an associated champ, reuse of SGA 4 notions with ell-adic coefficients, relatively smooth constructions, adic projective systems in derived categories, an introductory comment about restricted coefficients, and a requested identity involving D and i_*. There is no independent title or authorial page number. The lower-left 51 is recorded only as an archive sheet number. No date is visible. No explicit author question mark is visible: Essayer de faire expresses a proposed task, and (ou dans thèse) offers an alternative location. One numeral is cancelled and replaced by VI; adiques and a small sign above ou are additions. The two horizontal separators, insertion curves, framing rules, underlines, and isolated dot pair are included. I only checked visual readings and did not prove the final identity or consult mathematical background. Resolved or newly added uncertainty marks are counted as diff_c=true even when the preferred letters are unchanged. Retained unchanged C doubts have diff_c=false. Differences in the spelling of equivalent uncertainty/deletion macros alone are not counted as H differences.
math_reading_decisions: Retain the first connector X ni Y and the plain dash in X-Y; no logical or geometric reformulation is made.
Double-stroked handwritten Q and Z are transcribed as mathbb; the lowered loop is ell. D, F, X, and i have single stems.

The coefficient expression visibly includes a separate slash after the second Z. Its raised letter has an N-like angular form; N, n, and nu remain alternatives. The final marks are two horizontal dashes.

The generic-point character is read as eta from its short upright and rounded upper shoulder, also seen after sur and in the three F indices. It differs from the y in Systèmes. This is an ink comparison, not a deduction from the generic-point terminology.
The separator after i remains uncertain, with the visible angled shape favouring < over colon or membership; the usual syntax is not used to erase that ambiguity.
A faint bowed mark above the arrow shaft is retained as an uncertain tilde. This does not assert that the arrow is an isomorphism; intentional mark versus incidental trace remains open.
Both stars are subscripts on i. The two D letters and the nested parentheses are preserved without alteration.

completion: Full independent coverage of scan 052: the whole JPEG was viewed once for layout, then half a and half b once in order; every remaining local open place was inspected in one of 16 unique crops, each viewed once. Every textual block, formula, deletion, insertion, grouping mark, underline, separator, and marginal dot pair is transcribed or explicitly marked. Every C doubt and every observed substantive witness difference is recorded. No other page or reader output, OCR, external source, or published transcription was accessed.
